laws.rule: Paris charges a tourist tax per adult per night, collected by the host on top of the room price. Tariffs from 1 January 2026, all parts included: palace hotels EUR 15.93 (about A$25.31), five-star EUR 11.70 (A$18.59), four-star EUR 8.45 (A$13.43), three-star EUR 5.53 (A$8.79), two-star EUR 3.25 (A$5.16), one-star, guesthouses (chambres d'hôtes) and hostels EUR 2.60 (A$4.13), camping 3 to 5 stars EUR 1.95 (A$3.10), camping 1 and 2 stars EUR 0.65 (A$1.03). Unclassified or unrated places pay 5% of the per-person nightly price before VAT, plus the added parts, capped at EUR 15.93. The figure includes two regional surcharges set by the State for Île-de-France transport and the Grand Paris metro. The tariff is per adult; the table lists it per person of full age. AUD at the RBA rate of 30 October 2026, A$1 = EUR 0.6293.
